title: Cohort-aware bootstrapped NDCG pipeline and live A/B hooks for reranker
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a production pipeline to compute NDCG and MRR with bootstrapped confidence intervals at the customer-cohort and prompt-set level, and add lightweight A/B experiment hooks on the reranking endpoint so that live traffic can be evaluated end-to-end. Goals: (1) surface per-cohort quality with statistical confidence so PMs and data scientists can evaluate regressions, (2) keep end-to-end latency overhead < 3ms p50 for rerank calls, (3) scale to 10k active cohort tags without exploding query cost.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline produces daily NDCG@10 and MRR@10 for configured customer cohorts and prompt-set slices
Bootstrapped 95% confidence intervals computed per metric with at least 1k bootstrap samples by default
Rerank endpoint emits AB metadata (experiment_id, variant, cohort_tag, promptset_id) and these tags are ingested by the metrics pipeline within 5 minutes
End-to-end added latency on rerank path measured in synthetic load test is < 3ms p50 and < 10ms p95
Dashboards with cohort filters, CI shading, and time-series comparison available in Datadog; alert when a cohort's NDCG drops by >5% relative to baseline with CI overlap < 0
Rollout plan with canary traffic and automatic fallback to baseline variant implemented

risks: High cardinality of cohort tags can create expensive joins and increase query cost
Bootstrapping cost is compute-heavy for large customer histories; naive approach can be O(N * samples)
If AB metadata is added synchronously it could regress p95 latency on the rerank path
Small cohorts (<100 interactions) will have noisy CIs; need minimum-sample guardrails or aggregate buckets
